title: The Eye of the Practice
subtitle: Dr. REDA & Dr. RACHID are counting on you
synopsis:
Welcome, Doctor! 📸

Dr. RACHID has just installed a new dental chair and a camera. He is eager to capture his treatments. But he quickly discovers that dental photography is an art in itself.

Between macro lenses, aperture settings, shutter speed, ISO, white balance, ring flashes, and post-production... the path is full of obstacles.

A blurry photo, a distorted color, and communication with the patient suffers.

The precision of diagnosis, the quality of presentations, and the credibility of the practice rest on YOUR shoulders.

chapters.debutant1: Welcome, Doctor! Dr. RACHID has just installed a camera. He discovers the basics of dental photography: macro lenses, fundamental settings, ring flash, and the first shots.
chapters.debutant2: Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA deepen their knowledge of advanced techniques, reflection management, white balance, and photographic protocols for clinical cases.
chapters.intermediaire1: Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA face complex situations: advanced settings, photo protocols, management of specific clinical cases. They must master every parameter for quality images.
chapters.intermediaire2: Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA handle specific cases: prosthetics, implants, aesthetics, reflection and color management. They must adapt their technique to each clinical situation.
chapters.expert1: Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA become references in dental photography. They train young dentists on the importance of photography for diagnosis and communication.
chapters.expert2: After years of practice and innovation, Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA pass on their knowledge. They leave a legacy of photographic skills and excellence to the dental profession.

chapterEndings.debutant1: Dr. RACHID has laid the foundations of dental photography. But the road ahead is still long...
chapterEndings.debutant2: Advanced techniques are mastered. Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA are ready for more complex cases.
chapterEndings.intermediaire1: Technical mastery is acquired. Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA have gained confidence.
chapterEndings.intermediaire2: Specific cases are mastered. Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA are ready for greater challenges.
chapterEndings.expert1: Photographic strategy has become a key skill. Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA train young dentists.
chapterEndings.expert2: Dr. RACHID and Dr. REDA have accomplished their mission. Photography is the eye of the practice.
